subject: Create scripts directory structure and key scripts
description: Create scripts/ with subdirectories: setup/, validation/, utilities/, development/. Create key scripts: setup/test_connection.py, setup/create_schemas.py, validation/dry_run_pipeline.py (critical - finds issues before deploy), utilities/reset_schemas.py, utilities/list_conversions.py. Each script should use Databricks SDK with OAuth M2M auth from .databrickscfg.
